title: H5P
description: Plays H5P interactive content from an uploaded .h5p file, with no H5P server needed
demoHtml:
<h5p-element>
  <iframe width="100%" height="auto" src="https://media.ed.science.psu.edu/entity_iframe/node/4272" frameborder="0" class="entity_iframe entity_iframe_node" id="entity_iframe_node_2653" allowfullscreen="true" webkitallowfullscreen="true" mozallowfullscreen="true" style="height: 576px;"></iframe>
</h5p-element>

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Source of the H5P content: a .h5p file (unzipped in the browser) or the URL path to an extracted .h5p content folder

attributes.name: h5pLibPath
attributes.description: Optional override for the base URL where the h5p-standalone dist is served (must contain main.bundle.js, frame.bundle.js, styles/h5p.css). Set this to point at an on-prem copy when the default resolution does not match your deployment.

gizmo.title: H5P
gizmo.description: Plays H5P interactive content from an uploaded .h5p file, with no H5P server needed

configure.title: H5P file
configure.description: Upload or link a .h5p file. It is unpacked in the browser; no H5P server is required.

advanced.title: Legacy iframe embed code
advanced.description: Only for older content that embeds an H5P iframe from another site. Leave empty when a .h5p file is set above.
